ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to home and family.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1830110644000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.

The trine between Mars and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.
